# NAMI Greater Houston

> > NAMI Greater Houston provides mental health education, family support programs, and advocacy for individuals and families affected by mental illness in the Houston area.

The organization offers evidence-based programs like NAMI Family-to-Family, volunteer opportunities, and legislative advocacy through the Public Policy and Advocacy Committee (PPAC). NAMI Greater Houston is part of the national NAMI network and works to reduce stigma while connecting community members with peer-led mental health resources.

## Key Topics

- Mental health advocacy
- NAMI Family-to-Family program
- Peer-led support
- Family caregiver training
- Mental illness education
- Community support programs
- Stigma awareness
- Public policy advocacy
- PPAC legislative work
- Volunteer opportunities
- Mental health resources Houston
- Evidence-based programs
- SAMHSA recognition
- Nonprofit membership
- Charitable giving

## Education & Support Programs

- [Family-to-Family](https://namigreaterhouston.org/services/education-programs/family-to-family): SAMHSA-recognized peer-led family support & mental health education program

## Get Involved

- [Join NAMI](https://namigreaterhouston.org/join-nami): Membership page for joining NAMI Greater Houston advocacy community
- [Donate](https://namigreaterhouston.org/get-involved/donate): Donation page for supporting Houston mental health programs & services
- [Volunteer or Intern](https://namigreaterhouston.org/get-involved/volunteer-or-intern): Volunteer & internship opportunities in Houston mental health advocacy

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Public Policy and Advocacy Committee (PPAC)](https://namigreaterhouston.org/services/advocacy/public-policy-and-advocacy-committee): PPAC volunteer committee driving mental health legislative advocacy
